# GravityERD

GravityERD is a fully client-side database schema layout tool. Imported files never leave the browser.

Agent entry points:
- automation-contract.json — stable test IDs, root state attributes, and read-only browser API
- docs/playwright-mcp.md — supported Playwright MCP and human-in-the-loop workflow
- docs/formats.md — public project/workspace JSON formats and merge behavior
- examples/helpdesk.project.gravityerd.json — combined public example

Use the real file input and proposal UI for mutations. Use globalThis.gravityErdAutomation only for read-only inspection. Export to a repository through the Copy JSON controls and clipboard, never through an assumed browser download path.
